EXIT=0. Relevant bootstrap/digest placement rows, verbatim:
798:- **Provider launch:** the adapter defines its complete runtime closure. Before \`effect.activate\`, the wrapper resolves it, compares path/digest/version/capability/schema to the quote-bound \`ProviderRuntimeObservation\`, and pins it through a content-addressed private copy or platform-proven immutable handle. A mismatch is \`PROVIDER_CAPABILITY_CHANGED\`/\`HOLD_UNKNOWN\`; unsupported runtime pinning cannot launch authoritatively. The child inherits the OS-exclusive launch lock (or an OS job proves death) and registers with a one-time bootstrap credential. Duplicate delivery adopts the registered process or exits before provider launch. An uncertain \`ARMED\`/lock state becomes \`SUSPECT\` and is never auto-relaunched.
811:- Provider environments contain only scoped credentials and an allowlisted environment; secret values never enter receipts or context. An \`ExecutionEnvironmentManifest\` declares toolchain/runtime digests, network policy, caches, external services, registry/user-level inputs, and isolation/hermeticity capabilities.
1013:On a fresh install, an OS-local owner bootstrap credential performs:
1139:Loopback is the only default bind. UI sessions use OS-protected bootstrap material, secure same-site cookies, CSRF token, and strict Host/Origin validation. Credentials never appear in URLs or logs. Non-loopback refuses to start unless a reviewed policy explicitly enables authenticated transport security and allowed origins/hosts.
1141:MCP stdio receives a scoped bootstrap credential from its spawning process. Streamable HTTP uses authenticated sessions and the MCP authorization model. The daemon stores only necessary credential hashes/keys with OS-user permissions; receipt/export signing key rotation is audited.
No design row contains the literal bootstrapCredentialDigest. Line 798 establishes the launch credential; line 1141 establishes that the scoped bootstrap credential comes from the spawning process and the daemon stores its hash. Line 1013 is the separate OS-owner/bootstrap-journey credential; line 811 is the separate provider-API environment credential.
